mapper.select: SELECT * FROM courses WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY day_of_week, time_slot
SELECT * FROM courses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} ORDER BY time_slot
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses (user_id, name, teacher, room, day_of_week, time_slot, color, remind_enabled, remind_minutes, start_week, end_week, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{teacher}, #{room}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot}, #{color}, #{remindEnabled}, #{remindMinutes}, #{startWeek}, #{endWeek}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
